name: Second Wind Smash Repairs
description: A primer-grey and ocean-metallic paint-booth theme for smash repairers: a signature before/after spray-pass slider, a repairs gallery filtered by damage type with paint-code chips, a step-by-step insurance-claims guide with a printable at-the-scene checklist, courtesy cars parked in painted bays with availability signs, workshop hours and a Jamstacks contact component for quote and claim enquiries.
